topItems.title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API
topItems.excerpt: We are releasing cf, our new command-line tool that mirrors the entire Cloudflare API and supports programmatic TypeScript configuration. We are also open-sourcing Forge, our internal SDK generator.

brief.whatHappened: The Cloudflare Blog published "Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API".

keyConcepts.explanation: A program in which a model picks a tool, reads the result and decides the next step, repeating until the task is done or a limit stops it.
The model returns a structured request to call a function you defined. Your code runs it and sends the result back as the next message.
